nodes.name: Submit for Review
nodes.notes: Soumet une traduction pour revision. Payload: {translation_id, source_text, translation, commentaries: [{...}]}

nodes.name: Review Action
nodes.notes: Action de revision. Payload: {translation_id, action: 'approve'|'reject'|'retranslate', feedback?: string, reviewer?: string}

parameters.jsonBody:
={"content": "**Actions disponibles pour `{{ $json.translation_id }}`:**

Pour valider, utilisez curl ou un client HTTP:
```bash
curl -X POST '{{$env.N8N_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL }}/torah-review-action' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"translation_id": "{{ $json.translation_id }}", "action": "approve", "reviewer":"VotreNom"}'
```

Actions: `approve` |`reject` | `retranslate`"}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, translation_id: $json.translation_id, message: 'Submitted for review' } }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ segment_ids: $('Process Review Action').first().json.segment_id ? [$('Process Review Action').first().json.segment_id] : null, source_text_ids: $('Process Review Action').first().json.segment_id ? null : [$('Process Review Action').first().json.translation_id], config: { target_language: 'fr', translator: { provider: 'anthropic', model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514' }, reviewer: { provider: 'openai', model: 'gpt-4o' } }, retry_reason: $('Process Review Action').first().json.feedback || 'Retranslation requested' }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, translation_id: $('Process Review Action').first().json.translation_id, action: $('Process Review Action').first().json.action, status: $('Process Review Action').first().json.status } }}
